The disclosure from KSL Holding Private Limited under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 was received on October 1, 2021 to the Company. Accordingly, the Company has submitted reqiusite disclosure to Stock Exchanges on October 4, 2021
